markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any presidential actions on Nov 26, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Nov 27, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication date visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET the following day.

Payout criteria

The actions may include proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, and memoranda.
Any item listed on the page counts, regardless of its legal effect.

Examples (for Jan 10, 2026):

Executive Order with a Jan 7 signing date is released with a Jan 10 publication date → resolves Yes
Proclamation e-mailed to White House Press Pool but not uploaded by 10:00 AM next day → resolves No
Proclamation is released Jan 10 with a backdated Jan 9 publication date → resolves No
Bill signed into law and shows up on "Briefings & Statements" instead of "Presidential Actions" → resolves No

markets.rules_primary: If the close yield (%) of the 1-minute Pyth candlestick for 10-year U.S. Treasury ending at 8:15 AM EST on Nov 27, 2026 is at least the opening target yield, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the closing yield of the one-minute Pyth candlestick for 10-year U.S. Treasury ending at 8:15 AM EST on Nov 27, 2026. The 10-year U.S. Treasury refers to the US10Y, the current on-the-run benchmark of the 10-year U.S. Treasury Note as identified on the Source Agency. Revisions to the Underlying made after Expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

The settlement value is rounded to the nearest 5 decimal places.

Yields are expressed as annualized percentages.

The opening target and settlement yield each use the closing yield of the one-minute Pyth candlestick immediately preceding their observation time. For a 4:45–5:00 PM EDT market, the opening target uses the candle timestamped 4:44 PM, ending at 4:45 PM; settlement uses the candle timestamped 4:59 PM, ending at 5:00 PM. Candlesticks are timestamped by their start time.

If reliable Pyth data is unavailable, the contract’s no-data provisions apply.
